title: Space-Flow Node Manifest v2 (DRAFT)
description: Draft schema produced in Platform Core Phase 0.1 as input for Custom Node Platform Phase 2 (.sfpkg package format). Not yet wired to a validator — see specs/space-flow-master-plan/01-custom-node-platform.md Phase 2. Extends the v1 node.json shape (id/name/category/description/icon/inputs/outputs/config/executor, see nodes/*/node.json) with packaging, capability and resource-limit fields needed once nodes can come from an untrusted Registry instead of only the built-in nodes/ folder.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Built-in v1 node.json files have no schemaVersion field and are treated as 1.

packageId.description: Globally unique registry identifier, kebab-case. Distinct from the legacy node.type string used by built-in nodes.

entry.description: Executor entry file inside the package, e.g. execute.js or executor.py.

capabilities.description: Declarative permission grants, enforced by the Sandbox Host context SDK — see Custom Node Platform Phase 4. Absence of a field means the capability is denied (default deny).

network.description: Allowlisted domains this node is permitted to reach, e.g. ["api.elevenlabs.io"]. Empty/absent = no network access.

filesystem.description: "scratch" = context.scratchDir() only (default once any filesystem access is needed). "user-approved-path" requires the node to declare and the user to approve a specific path at install time.

secrets.description: Named credential slots this node may request via context.secret(name). Values are never exposed to node code directly — see docs/decisions/0008-custom-node-sandbox-architecture.md.

process.description: Whether the node may spawn subprocesses (e.g. ffmpeg). Default denied.

spaceFlow.description: SemVer range this package version is compatible with, e.g. ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0".

behavior.description: Optional declarations used by the runner for retry/log-level UX — see Custom Node Platform §2.

columns.description: Only used by "table" type fields: editable-grid column definitions. A table field without this falls back to a raw JSON editor in the UI.
